铵盐与强碱共热，管口略向下、用碱石灰干燥: Heat an ammonium salt with a strong base, tube mouth tilted slightly down, dry with soda lime
氨比空气轻 → 瓶口向下收集，收得越久越纯: Ammonia is lighter than air → collect with the mouth down; the longer you collect, the purer it gets
1 体积水溶约 700 体积氨 → 瓶内压强骤降: 1 volume of water dissolves about 700 volumes of ammonia → flask pressure plunges
内外差 94.5 kPa 把水压进烧瓶 → 酚酞红色喷泉: A 94.5 kPa difference pushes water into the flask → red phenolphthalein fountain
一条气路 + 一瓶氨 + 一场喷泉: One gas line + one flask of ammonia + one fountain
整体 · 造氨、收氨、检验，最后用它做喷泉: Overview · make ammonia, collect it, test it, then use it for a fountain

全对！喷泉的动力是「氨极易溶 → 瓶内压强骤降 → 大气压压水」。: All correct! The fountain is driven by "ammonia is extremely soluble → flask pressure plunges → air pressure pushes water in".

喷泉：瓶内水柱、烧杯液面下降、酚酞红色: Fountain: water column in the flask, beaker level falls, red phenolphthalein
烧瓶内 · 示意放大（氨分子溶进水里、OH⁻ 出现）: Inside the flask · close-up (ammonia molecules dissolve in water, OH⁻ appears)
铁架台上夹住的大试管：管口略向下倾斜、塞一团棉花，管内 NH₄Cl 与 Ca(O: A large test tube clamped on a stand: mouth tilted slightly down, plugged with cotton, NH₄Cl and Ca(OH)₂ solids inside, heated at the bottom with an alcohol lamp (textbook Fig. 5-13)
球形干燥管（碱石灰）+ 瓶口朝下的集气瓶；瓶口旁一片湿润红色石蕊试纸与一根蘸浓盐: Bulb drying tube (soda lime) + a gas jar with its mouth down; next to the mouth, moist red litmus paper and a glass rod dipped in concentrated HCl
倒置的干燥圆底烧瓶，塞子上插着胶头滴管与短玻璃管，玻璃管伸进盛酚酞水的烧杯，中间: An inverted dry round-bottom flask with a dropper and a short glass tube through the stopper; the glass tube reaches into a beaker of phenolphthalein water, with a pinch clamp in between (textbook Fig. 5-11)
台面后上方的圆视窗：氨分子成批溶进水里、瓶内气体分子数骤减、液面上出现 OH⁻（: Round window above the back of the bench: ammonia molecules dissolve into the water in batches, the gas molecule count in the flask plunges, and OH⁻ appears at the surface (schematic close-up)
桌上这一串东西，哪一段在「造」氨，哪一段在「收」氨？: Of this row of equipment on the bench, which part "makes" ammonia and which part "collects" it?
拖动视角，绕这张实验台看一圈（滚轮可拉近）: Drag the view around the bench (scroll to zoom)
四个站位都在：① 铁架台上夹着一支大试管（管口略向下、塞着棉花，管底有酒精灯）；: All four stations are here: ① a large test tube clamped on a stand (mouth slightly down, cotton plug, alcohol lamp underneath); ② a bulb drying tube leading to a gas jar with its mouth down; ③ an inverted round-bottom flask on a stand, with a dropper and glass tube through the stopper, the tube reaching into a beaker of phenolphthalein water; ④ the magnified window above the back of the bench. Main reading 0.0 % (collection not started)
加热固体 · 管口略向下倾斜 · 碱石灰干燥 · 向下排空气: Heat solids · tube mouth tilted slightly down · soda lime drying · downward air displacement
从左到右就是操作顺序：造 → 干燥 → 收集 → 检验 → 喷泉。: Left to right is the order of operations: make → dry → collect → test → fountain.
① 段到 ② 段之间有导管连着，氨气是一路走过去的；③ 的烧瓶里装的是同样收集好: Sections ① and ② are joined by tubing, so the ammonia flows straight through; the flask at ③ holds a flask of ammonia collected the same way (the dashed "same flask of ammonia": fill it, stopper it, then use it for the fountain).
教材图5-13 把「造」和「收」放在同一支试管里（管口塞棉花）；本课在教材图 5: Textbook Fig. 5-13 makes and collects in one test tube (cotton plug at the mouth); this lesson adds a drying tube to Fig. 5-13, spreading it into a "generate → dry → collect" chain. Adding a drying tube is a common exam variant, not in the textbook figure.
去掉这一步：学生不知道自己在看哪一段，后面每改一个开关都对不上位置。: Skip this step and students don't know which part they're looking at, and later switches don't match up with positions.
Common exam topic: the four-part structure of lab gas preparation, "generate – purify – collect – tail gas" (curriculum standard printed p.13, suggested learning activity).
这就是教材第五章第二节「氨和铵盐」里的两套装置摆在一张台面上：一套造氨并收集（图: These are the two setups from textbook Ch. 5, Sec. 2 "Ammonia and Ammonium Salts" on one bench: one to make and collect ammonia (Fig. 5-13), one to use that flask for a fountain (Fig. 5-11).
加热固体的试管，口为什么不能朝上？: Why can't the mouth of a test tube heating solids point upward?
把「试管口」从向上拨成略向下倾斜，同时盯住右边的风险条: Switch "Tube mouth" from upward to tilted slightly down, while watching the risk bar on the right
管口向上时：试管口一侧有水珠凝聚、冷凝水沿管壁往管底流，风险条升到 0.85（报: Mouth up: water droplets condense near the mouth and run back down the wall to the tube bottom; the risk bar rises to 0.85 (alarm), labeled "Condensate flows back · tube may crack"; ammonia is still produced (the ammonia fraction in the jar is still 93.3 %). Tilted slightly down, the condensate runs out of the mouth and the risk bar drops back to 0.10
加热固体 · 管口略向下倾斜 · 管口塞棉花: Heat solids · mouth tilted slightly down · cotton plug at the mouth
「略向下倾斜」倾斜的是管口，不是管底——写成「管底略向下」是错的。: "Tilted slightly down" refers to the mouth, not the bottom; writing "bottom slightly down" is wrong.
管口向上的问题不是「收不到氨」：氨照样产生，读数一点不变；危险在冷凝水会倒流到灼: The problem with mouth up isn't "no ammonia": ammonia is still made and the reading doesn't change at all. The danger is that condensate flows back onto the hot bottom and the tube may crack.
棉花塞在管口，是防止固体粉末被气流带出去；它挡不住冷凝水。: The cotton at the mouth keeps solid powder from being carried out by the gas; it doesn't stop condensate.
去掉这一步：学生会照着背「管口向下」，却以为那是为了提高产率，答不到安全原因。: Skip this step and students memorize "mouth down" but think it raises the yield, missing the safety reason.
高频：加热固体的试管口为什么要略向下倾斜（安全原因）；棉花的作用是什么。: Frequently tested: why the mouth of a tube heating solids tilts slightly down (safety); what the cotton is for.
加热固体时药品里的水蒸气会在管口冷凝；管口朝上时冷凝水会倒流到灼热的管底，可能使: When heating solids, water vapor from the reagents condenses at the mouth; with the mouth up, the condensate flows back onto the hot bottom and may crack the tube. Textbook Fig. 5-13 draws the mouth tilted slightly down precisely so the condensate runs out.
A3.2、A7.4、B1、B2.1 算子 5、D10: A3.2, A7.4, B1, B2.1 operator 5, D10
中间这个干燥管里，能不能装浓硫酸？: Can the drying tube in the middle be filled with concentrated sulfuric acid?
把干燥剂从「浓硫酸」拨成「碱石灰」，看集气瓶里的读数: Switch the drying agent from "conc. H₂SO₄" to "soda lime" and watch the reading in the gas jar
装浓硫酸时集气瓶里一直收不到氨，瓶内氨的体积分数停在 0.0 %（氨被酸吸掉了）: With concentrated sulfuric acid no ammonia ever reaches the jar, and the ammonia fraction stays at 0.0 % (the acid absorbs it), so the fountain can't be done either; with soda lime it rises to 93.3 % (both after 10 min of collection)
氨是碱性气体 · 干燥剂必须碱性（教材未写，按「氨与酸反应」推出）: Ammonia is a basic gas · the drying agent must be basic (not in the textbook; inferred from "ammonia reacts with acids")
干燥管要放在「发生」之后、「收集」之前——顺序错了等于没干燥。: The drying tube goes after "generate" and before "collect"; in the wrong order it doesn't dry anything.
判断干燥剂能不能用，看的是气体的酸碱性，不是「吸不吸水」。: Whether a drying agent works depends on the gas being acidic or basic, not on "does it absorb water".
教材 p.13–15 没有写干燥剂这一步，这一段是按「氨与酸反应生成铵盐」这条性: Textbook pp.13–15 don't cover a drying step; this part is inferred from the property "ammonia reacts with acids to form ammonium salts", and the screen doesn't present it as textbook wording.
去掉这一步：学生记住「用碱石灰」却说不清为什么不能用浓硫酸。: Skip this step and students remember "use soda lime" but can't explain why concentrated sulfuric acid won't do.
高频：为什么不能用浓硫酸干燥氨气；碱性气体该用什么干燥剂。: Frequently tested: why concentrated sulfuric acid can't dry ammonia; which drying agents suit basic gases.
氨是碱性气体，遇到酸会生成铵盐（NH₃ + HCl = NH₄Cl）；浓硫酸是酸: Ammonia is a basic gas that forms ammonium salts with acids (NH₃ + HCl = NH₄Cl); concentrated sulfuric acid is an acidic drying agent that would absorb all the ammonia, so only basic drying agents like soda lime will work.
A4.5、A6.5、A7.6、B1、B2.1 算子 1、D5: A4.5, A6.5, A7.6, B1, B2.1 operator 1, D5
为什么这只集气瓶要瓶口朝下放？: Why is this gas jar placed mouth down?
把收集方式从「瓶口向上」拨成「瓶口向下」，看瓶内氨的体积分数: Switch the collection method from "mouth up" to "mouth down" and watch the ammonia fraction in the jar
瓶口向上时只有 9.3 %（氨往上跑了），低于 25 % 的形成阈值；改成瓶口向: Mouth up gives only 9.3 % (the ammonia escapes upward), below the 25 % threshold for a fountain; mouth down gives 93.3 % (same 10 min collection), about ten times more
氨的密度比空气的小 · 瓶口向下收集（向下排空气法）: Ammonia is less dense than air · collect mouth down (downward air displacement)
判断收集方法看密度：比空气小 → 瓶口向下收集；比空气大 → 瓶口向上收集。: Choose the collection method by density: lighter than air → collect mouth down; heavier than air → collect mouth up.
「向下」说的是瓶口朝下，不是「把瓶子放低」。: "Down" means the jar's mouth faces down, not "put the jar lower".
9.3 % 不是「收得少一点」，是低于喷泉能形成的阈值——第 7 步会看到水几乎: 9.3 % isn't "a bit less"; it's below the fountain threshold, and in step 7 you'll see the water barely moves.
去掉这一步：学生做喷泉失败时找不到原因。: Skip this step and students can't find the cause when the fountain fails.
高频：氨气的收集方法及理由；氨与空气的密度比较（17 对 29）。: Frequently tested: how to collect ammonia and why; comparing the density of ammonia and air (17 vs 29).
氨的密度比空气的小，瓶口朝下时氨沉在瓶里把空气顶出去；瓶口朝上则氨向上逸散，收不: Ammonia is less dense than air, so with the mouth down it fills the jar from the top and pushes the air out; with the mouth up it escapes upward and isn't collected.
A4.1、A5.4、A7.5、B1、B2.1 算子 1、D6、D7: A4.1, A5.4, A7.5, B1, B2.1 operator 1, D6, D7
只收两分钟，够不够做喷泉？: Is two minutes of collecting enough for a fountain?
把收集时间从 0 拖到 2 min、5 min、10 min，看读数与曲线上的点: Drag the collection time from 0 to 2 min, 5 min and 10 min and watch the reading and the point on the curve
收 0 min 时 0.0 %（水根本不动）；1 min 31.3 %（喷泉只升: At 0 min, 0.0 % (the water doesn't move at all); 1 min 31.3 % (the fountain rises only 3.8 cm, just past the threshold); 2 min 52.3 % (6.3 cm); 5 min 82.1 % (9.9 cm); 10 min 93.3 % (11.2 cm). The point on the curve follows the slider
向下排空气法 · 收集 0 → 10 min · 形成阈值 25 %: Downward air displacement · collect 0 → 10 min · threshold 25 %
体积分数上升是先快后慢（时间常数 2.5 min），不是匀速。: The volume fraction rises fast at first, then slowly (time constant 2.5 min), not at a steady rate.
1 min 就过了 25 % 的形成阈值，但喷泉只升 3.8 cm（2 min: It passes the 25 % threshold within 1 min, but the fountain only rises 3.8 cm (6.3 cm at 2 min): "it sprays" and "it sprays well" are two different things.
教材不给收集时间，这条曲线与这几个数是课件设定（示意），只用来讲趋势。: The textbook gives no collection time; this curve and these numbers are lesson settings (illustrative), only to show the trend.
去掉这一步：学生以为「收一下就行」，说不清实验课为什么要收很久。: Skip this step and students think "collecting briefly is fine" and can't explain why lab classes collect for so long.
常考：排空气法收集的效率与纯度；「充满」是理想化的说法。: Common exam topic: efficiency and purity of air-displacement collection; "filled" is an idealization.
排空气法是「氨一点点把空气顶出去」，所以瓶内氨的体积分数随时间上升、先快后慢，收: Air displacement means "ammonia gradually pushes the air out", so the ammonia fraction in the jar rises over time, fast at first and then slowly, approaching the 95 % ceiling the longer you collect.
B1、B2.1 算子 1、标准值表 2–6、D3: B1, B2.1 operator 1, standard values tables 2–6, D3
验满与白烟: Testing for full and white smoke
怎么知道这瓶收满了？瓶口那团白烟又是什么？: How do you know this jar is full? And what's the white smoke at the mouth?
点一下瓶口那根蘸浓盐酸的玻璃棒（不动手也行，会自动替你点）: Tap the glass rod dipped in concentrated HCl by the mouth (or don't; it will be tapped for you automatically)
湿润的红色石蕊试纸在瓶口变蓝（氨水显碱性，这就是验满的依据）；玻璃棒靠近瓶口，瓶: The moist red litmus paper at the mouth turns blue (ammonia water is basic; this is how you check it's full); bring the glass rod near the mouth and white smoke appears: tiny solid particles from NH₃ + HCl = NH₄Cl. If collection failed earlier (steps 3 or 4 done wrong), the paper doesn't turn blue and there's no white smoke
湿润红色石蕊试纸 · 蘸浓盐酸的玻璃棒: Moist red litmus paper · glass rod dipped in concentrated HCl
验满要用湿润的试纸：氨是气体，得先溶于水生成 NH₃·H₂O 并电离出 OH⁻: Use moist paper to check it's full: ammonia is a gas and only shows basicity after dissolving in water to form NH₃·H₂O, which ionizes to give OH⁻.
白烟是固体（NH₄Cl 小颗粒），不是白雾（液滴）——「烟」与「雾」不能混。: White smoke is a solid (NH₄Cl particles), not white mist (droplets); don't confuse "smoke" and "mist".
变蓝的是红色石蕊试纸（不是蓝色石蕊试纸）；酚酞要到第 7 步的喷泉才用。: It's red litmus paper that turns blue (not blue litmus paper); phenolphthalein isn't used until the fountain in step 7.
去掉这一步：学生不知道「收满」怎么判断，也不知道那团白烟是什么。: Skip this step and students don't know how to tell the jar is full or what the white smoke is.
高频：氨的检验（湿润红色石蕊试纸变蓝、遇浓盐酸产生白烟）；烟与雾的区别。: Frequently tested: testing for ammonia (moist red litmus turns blue, white smoke with concentrated HCl); the difference between smoke and mist.
氨遇氯化氢迅速反应生成氯化铵晶体（教材原话），所以看到的是白烟；氨水显弱碱性，能: Ammonia reacts quickly with hydrogen chloride to form ammonium chloride crystals (textbook wording), so you see white smoke; ammonia water is weakly basic, turning red litmus blue and phenolphthalein red. This is the basis for checking and identifying it.
只挤一下胶头滴管，水怎么就自己冲上去了？: You only squeeze the dropper once. How does the water rush up by itself?
挤压胶头滴管，让水进入烧瓶，看水柱和旁边的三个读数: Squeeze the dropper to let water into the flask, and watch the water column and the three readings beside it
挤压后瓶内水柱冲到瓶顶，形成粉红色喷泉，液面升到 11.2 cm；压强差从 0: After squeezing, the water rushes to the top of the flask as a pink fountain and the level rises to 11.2 cm; the pressure difference jumps from 0 to 94.5 kPa, the flask pressure drops from 101.3 kPa to 6.8 kPa, the color cell changes from "colorless" to "red", and the beaker level falls
挤压胶头滴管 · 酚酞水 · 弹簧夹打开: Squeeze the dropper · phenolphthalein water · pinch clamp open
动力来自瓶内外的压强差，不是「水自己会往上流」。: The force comes from the pressure difference between inside and outside the flask, not "water flowing upward by itself".
喷泉是红色的：水里预先滴了酚酞，而氨水显弱碱性。: The fountain is red: phenolphthalein was added to the water beforehand, and ammonia water is weakly basic.
挤压胶头滴管那一点水只是引子——它让瓶里的氨有了能溶进去的水，之后的水是被大气压: The little water from the dropper is just a starter: it gives the ammonia some water to dissolve in; the rest of the water is pushed in by air pressure.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「喷泉实验」，说不出哪一步让压强变了。: Skip this step and students can only recite "fountain experiment" without saying which step changed the pressure.
高频：喷泉实验的原理（极易溶 → 压强骤降 → 大气压压水）；为什么喷泉是红色。: Frequently tested: the principle of the fountain experiment (extremely soluble → pressure plunges → air pressure pushes water); why the fountain is red.
氨极易溶于水（1 体积水约溶 700 体积氨），水一进瓶，瓶内气体几乎全被吸进水: Ammonia is extremely soluble in water (1 volume of water dissolves about 700 volumes of ammonia). Once water enters the flask, almost all the gas dissolves, the flask pressure plunges far below atmospheric, and air pressure pushes water from the beaker up the glass tube into the flask, making a fountain; ammonia water is weakly basic, so phenolphthalein turns red.
A3.1、A4.2、A4.4、A4.6、B2.1 算子 2–4、标准值表 11、: A3.1, A4.2, A4.4, A4.6, B2.1 operators 2–4, standard values table 11, D1, D2, D8
瓶子里到底少了什么，才让水被吸上去？: What exactly went missing from the flask to make the water rise?
看视窗里 40 个氨分子成批溶进水里（也可以点视窗推近）: Watch the 40 ammonia molecules in the window dissolve into the water in batches (tap the window to zoom in)
视窗里 40 个淡蓝色氨分子，水一渗进来就成批进入液面、最后只剩 2 个，液面上: In the window, 40 pale blue ammonia molecules enter the water surface in batches as soon as water seeps in, until only 2 remain; 12 blue OH⁻ dots appear on the surface and it turns pink; the gas molecule count in the flask drops from full to almost none. That's why the flask pressure falls from 101.3 kPa to 6.8 kPa
变的是气体分子数（分子跑进水里了），不是「瓶里的空气被抽走了」。: What changes is the number of gas molecules (they went into the water), not "the air in the flask was pumped out".
OH⁻ 是「氨水显碱性」的直接原因，酚酞变红就是它在起作用。: OH⁻ is the direct reason "ammonia water is basic", and it's what turns phenolphthalein red.
水进去的体积约等于氨原来占的体积，所以最后水面几乎顶到瓶颈。: The volume of water entering is about the volume the ammonia took up, so in the end the water nearly reaches the neck.
去掉这一步：学生记住了「压强变小」，却不知道分子去哪了。: Skip this step and students remember "the pressure drops" but not where the molecules went.
高频：用分子与压强的角度解释喷泉实验；氨水显碱性的原因。: Frequently tested: explaining the fountain experiment in terms of molecules and pressure; why ammonia water is basic.
氨分子极易溶于水并与水结合成一水合氨，一水合氨小部分电离出 NH₄⁺ 和 OH⁻: Ammonia molecules are extremely soluble and combine with water to form ammonia monohydrate, a small part of which ionizes to NH₄⁺ and OH⁻; the number of gas molecules in the flask plunges, the pressure plunges with it, and air pressure pushes the water in. (Textbook Exp. 5-6 asks you to "analyze the possible causes of these phenomena"; this explanation is the answer.)
考核：按教材把这瓶氨收到最干净，然后让它喷起来: Assessment: collect this flask of ammonia as cleanly as the textbook does, then make it spray
加热 + 管口略向下 + 碱石灰 + 瓶口向下收集到 10 min，再把胶头滴管: Heat + mouth slightly down + soda lime + collect mouth down for 10 min, then squeeze the dropper, so the ammonia fraction is ≥ 90.0 % and the fountain reaches ≥ 9.0 cm, held for 15 seconds; partway through the collection method will be switched to mouth up
达标横幅「喷泉实验 · 达标」；进入 5 s 后收集方式被拨成瓶口向上（体积分数: Pass banner "Fountain experiment · passed"; at 5 s the collection method is switched to mouth up (fraction drops to 9.3 %, fountain disappears), and you must switch it back. The reference setup follows the textbook throughout, collects for 10 min, and reads 93.3 % and 11.2 cm when the dropper is squeezed
收集方式最容易漏：一拨成瓶口向上，体积分数就掉到 9.3 %，低于 25 % 阈: The collection method is the easiest to miss: switch to mouth up and the fraction drops to 9.3 %, below the 25 % threshold, and the fountain is gone.
干燥剂与加热都会让体积分数归零，前几步做错这里就做不出来。: The drying agent and heating can both send the fraction to zero; if earlier steps are wrong, this one won't work.
挤压只是引子：水能不能上来，取决于瓶里到底有多少氨。: Squeezing is only the starter: whether the water rises depends on how much ammonia is actually in the flask.
满分结构：加热 + 管口略向下 + 碱石灰 + 瓶口向下收集 + 收满 + 挤压: Full-marks structure: heat + mouth slightly down + soda lime + collect mouth down + collect until full + squeeze the dropper.
考核没有新结论：造得出、收得净，才喷得高——四件事（加热、管口、干燥剂、收集方式: The assessment has no new conclusion: make it, collect it clean, and only then does it spray high. Four conditions (heating, mouth, drying agent, collection method) plus one action (squeezing), and none can be missing.

本班目标：加热固体、管口略向下、碱石灰干燥、瓶口向下收集 10 min、挤压胶头: Class goal: heat the solids, mouth slightly down, dry with soda lime, collect mouth down for 10 min, squeeze the dropper, so the ammonia fraction is ≥ 90.0 % and the fountain reaches ≥ 9.0 cm, held for 15 seconds (textbook Fig. 5-11 + Fig. 5-13)
氨的喷泉实验能形成，根本原因是: The fundamental reason the ammonia fountain experiment works is
氨与水反应放热，把水顶上去: Ammonia reacts with water and releases heat, pushing the water up
氨极易溶于水，瓶内气体分子数骤减、压强骤降，大气压把水压进烧瓶: Ammonia is extremely soluble, so the gas molecule count and pressure in the flask plunge, and air pressure pushes water into the flask
瓶内被抽成了真空: The flask was pumped into a vacuum
氨的密度比空气小，把水吸上来: Ammonia is less dense than air and sucks the water up
教材【实验5-6】要求分析原因：常温常压下 1 体积水大约可溶解 700 体积氨: Textbook Exp. 5-6 asks for the cause: at room temperature and pressure 1 volume of water dissolves about 700 volumes of ammonia (printed p.14), so once water enters the flask almost all the ammonia dissolves, the gas molecule count and pressure plunge, and air pressure pushes water from the beaker into the flask. Low density is the reason for the collection method, not the cause of the fountain.
喷泉实验中水柱是红色的，说明: The red water column in the fountain experiment shows that
氨水显碱性，使酚酞溶液变红: Ammonia water is basic and turns phenolphthalein red
氨水显酸性，使石蕊变红: Ammonia water is acidic and turns litmus red
水中溶解了氯化铵: Ammonium chloride is dissolved in the water
教材原话：氨的水溶液（俗称氨水）显弱碱性，能使酚酞溶液变红或使红色石蕊试纸变蓝（: Textbook wording: the aqueous solution of ammonia (commonly called ammonia water) is weakly basic and turns phenolphthalein red or red litmus paper blue (printed p.14). Option C of practice question 4 on p.18, "the red fountain shows ammonia water is basic", is exactly the correct statement.
实验室用 NH₄Cl 与 Ca(OH)₂ 固体加热制氨时，试管口要略向下倾斜，原: When preparing ammonia in the lab by heating solid NH₄Cl with Ca(OH)₂, the tube mouth should tilt slightly down because
让氨气容易排出，提高产率: It lets ammonia escape easily and raises the yield
防止药品中的水蒸气在管口冷凝后倒流到灼热的管底，使试管炸裂: It keeps water vapor from the reagents from condensing at the mouth and flowing back onto the hot bottom, cracking the tube
让固体受热更均匀: It heats the solid more evenly
教材图5-13 把管口画成略向下倾斜。管口向上的危险是冷凝水倒流到灼热的管底可能: Textbook Fig. 5-13 draws the mouth tilted slightly down. The danger with mouth up is condensate flowing back onto the hot bottom and possibly cracking the tube; it has nothing to do with "how much ammonia you get". This lesson shows it as a risk bar rather than a smaller reading.
向上排空气法，因为氨比空气轻: Upward air displacement, because ammonia is lighter than air
向下排空气法，因为氨比空气轻: Downward air displacement, because ammonia is lighter than air
排水法，因为氨不溶于水: Water displacement, because ammonia doesn't dissolve in water
向上排空气法，因为氨比空气重: Upward air displacement, because ammonia is heavier than air
教材原话：氨是无色、有刺激性气味的气体，密度比空气的小（印刷 p.13）。M(N: Textbook wording: ammonia is a colorless gas with a pungent smell, less dense than air (printed p.13). M(NH₃) = 17 < air's 29, so collect it mouth down (downward air displacement); ammonia is extremely soluble, so water displacement won't work either.
干燥氨气可以选用的干燥剂是: A drying agent that can be used for ammonia is
氨是碱性气体，遇到酸会生成铵盐（NH₃ + HCl = NH₄Cl，教材印刷 p: Ammonia is a basic gas that forms ammonium salts with acids (NH₃ + HCl = NH₄Cl, textbook printed p.14), and concentrated sulfuric acid would absorb it, so only basic drying agents like soda lime will work. The textbook doesn't cover this step; it's inferred from the property "ammonia reacts with acids".
检验氨气是否收集满，最合适的做法是: The best way to check whether a jar of ammonia is full is
把湿润的红色石蕊试纸放在瓶口，变蓝即满: Hold moist red litmus paper at the mouth; it's full when the paper turns blue
把干燥的蓝色石蕊试纸放在瓶口，变红即满: Hold dry blue litmus paper at the mouth; it's full when the paper turns red
闻气味，有刺激性气味即满: Smell it; it's full when there's a pungent smell
用蘸浓硫酸的玻璃棒靠近瓶口，看有无白烟: Bring a glass rod dipped in concentrated sulfuric acid near the mouth and look for white smoke
氨是气体，必须先溶于水生成 NH₃·H₂O 并电离出 OH⁻ 才显碱性，所以要用: Ammonia is a gas and only shows basicity after dissolving in water to form NH₃·H₂O, which ionizes to give OH⁻, so use moist red litmus paper (textbook Exp. 5-7 on p.14 uses moist red litmus paper); it's full when the paper turns blue. Smelling is unsafe and imprecise; white smoke needs a glass rod dipped in concentrated hydrochloric acid (NH₃ + HCl = NH₄Cl).
酒精灯点燃：铵盐与强碱共热，开始产生氨: Alcohol lamp lit: the ammonium salt and strong base are heated together and ammonia starts forming
酒精灯熄灭：不再产生氨: Alcohol lamp out: no more ammonia is made
试管口改成略向下倾斜：冷凝水顺着管口流出去，风险解除: Tube mouth tilted slightly down: condensate runs out of the mouth, risk cleared
试管口朝上：冷凝水会倒流到灼热的管底，试管可能炸裂（氨照样在产生，读数不变）: Tube mouth up: condensate will flow back onto the hot bottom and the tube may crack (ammonia is still being made; the reading doesn't change)
干燥剂换成碱石灰：氨不再被吸收: Drying agent changed to soda lime: ammonia is no longer absorbed
干燥剂换成浓硫酸：氨是碱性气体，被浓硫酸吸掉了，收不到氨: Drying agent changed to concentrated sulfuric acid: ammonia is a basic gas and is absorbed by the acid, so none is collected
改成瓶口向下收集：氨比空气轻，能把空气顶出去: Collecting mouth down: ammonia is lighter than air and pushes the air out
改成瓶口向上收集：氨向上逸散，瓶内氨的体积分数掉到一成: Collecting mouth up: ammonia escapes upward and the ammonia fraction in the jar drops to about a tenth
挤压胶头滴管：水进入烧瓶，氨溶进水里，瓶内压强骤降——水被大气压压上来: Dropper squeezed: water enters the flask, ammonia dissolves, and the flask pressure plunges, so air pressure pushes the water up
松开胶头滴管：瓶内压强回到常压，喷泉停止: Dropper released: the flask pressure returns to normal and the fountain stops
异常：收集方式被拨成瓶口向上了——体积分数掉到 9.3 %，先把它拨回来: Fault: the collection method was switched to mouth up. The fraction drops to 9.3 %, so switch it back first
已回到参考工况：全部按教材、收满 10 min、胶头滴管未挤压: Back to the reference setup: all per the textbook, collected for 10 min, dropper not squeezed
本课目标：先按教材把氨制出来、收干净（发生 → 干燥 → 收集 → 验满），再用: Lesson goal: first make ammonia and collect it clean following the textbook (generate → dry → collect → check full), then use that flask to understand the chain "extremely soluble → pressure plunges → air pressure pushes water" and make a red fountain.
示意声明：器材尺寸（圆底烧瓶 250 mL、大试管 Φ25 × 200 mm 等: Disclaimer: equipment sizes (250 mL round-bottom flask, Φ25 × 200 mm large test tube, etc.), collection time, ammonia fraction in the flask, pressure difference across the flask, fountain height and the fountain threshold are teaching illustrations (lesson settings); the textbook doesn't give these numbers. The apparatus and procedure come from PEP Required Book 2 Fig. 5-13 (simple lab apparatus for preparing ammonia, printed p.15), Fig. 5-11 and Exp. 5-6 (fountain experiment, printed p.13), and Fig. 5-12 (ammonia and hydrogen chloride, printed p.14). "1 volume of water dissolves about 700 volumes of ammonia", "less dense than air" and "ammonia water is weakly basic" are textbook wording (printed pp.13–14). For the choice of drying agent, checking that the jar is full, handling excess ammonia, and the glass rod dipped in concentrated HCl, the textbook only gives properties or poses questions without describing procedures; this lesson infers them from those properties (not presented as textbook wording). Atmospheric pressure is taken as 101.3 kPa.
